```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
```


# load regional T 

```{r}
B1_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_B1.csv")
B2_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_B2.csv")
CH_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_CH.csv")
CM_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_CM.csv")
IA_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_IA.csv")
ME_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_ME.csv")
GSP_BI_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_GSP_BI.csv")
GSP_LI_reg_T <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_T_GSP_LI.csv")

dat.list_reg_T <- list(
  ME = ME_reg_T,
  IA = IA_reg_T,
  GSP_LI = GSP_LI_reg_T,
  GSP_BI = GSP_BI_reg_T,
  CM = CM_reg_T,
  CH = CH_reg_T,  
  B1 = B1_reg_T,
  B2 = B2_reg_T
)

dat.list_reg_T <- lapply(dat.list_reg_T, function(reg) {           
  colnames(reg) <- c("date", "Temp")
  return(reg)
})

Reg_T_upto2025 <- bind_rows(dat.list_reg_T, .id = "site") # vertically merge dataframes and create a new column that indicates sites
Reg_T_upto2025$date_parsed <- ymd(Reg_T_upto2025$date)   # first parse the date that is in mdy_hms format
Reg_T_upto2025$month <- month(Reg_T_upto2025$date_parsed)
Reg_T_upto2025$day   <- day(Reg_T_upto2025$date_parsed)
Reg_T_upto2025$year  <- year(Reg_T_upto2025$date_parsed)
```

# regional P
```{r}
B1_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_B1.csv")
B2_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_B2.csv")
CH_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_CH.csv")
CM_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_CM.csv")
IA_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_IA.csv")
ME_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_ME.csv")
GSP_BI_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_GSP_BI.csv")
GSP_LI_reg_P <- read.csv("F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/raw-data/ClimateEngine_P_GSP_LI.csv")

dat.list_reg_P <- list(
  ME = ME_reg_P,
  IA = IA_reg_P,
  GSP_LI = GSP_LI_reg_P,
  GSP_BI = GSP_BI_reg_P,
  CM = CM_reg_P,
  CH = CH_reg_P,  
  B1 = B1_reg_P,
  B2 = B2_reg_P
)

dat.list_reg_P <- lapply(dat.list_reg_P, function(reg) {           
  colnames(reg) <- c("date", "Prec")
  return(reg)
})

reg_P_upto2025 <- bind_rows(dat.list_reg_P, .id = "site") # vertically merge dataframes and create a new column that indicates sites
reg_P_upto2025$date_parsed <- ymd(reg_P_upto2025$date)   # first parse the date that is in mdy_hms format
reg_P_upto2025$month <- month(reg_P_upto2025$date_parsed)
reg_P_upto2025$day   <- day(reg_P_upto2025$date_parsed)
reg_P_upto2025$year  <- year(reg_P_upto2025$date_parsed)
```

# join P and T and create startyear and newMonth
```{r}
Reg_clim_upto2025 <- reg_P_upto2025 %>% 
  left_join(Reg_T_upto2025, by = c( "site"  ,   "date" ,        "date_parsed", "month"  ,     "day"     ,  "year"))


Reg_clim_upto2025$startyear <- NA
Reg_clim_upto2025$startyear <- ifelse(
  ((Reg_clim_upto2025$month > 6) | (Reg_clim_upto2025$month == 6 & Reg_clim_upto2025$day >= 15)),
  Reg_clim_upto2025$year,
  (Reg_clim_upto2025$year)-1
)

Reg_clim_upto2025$newMonth <- NA
Reg_clim_upto2025$newMonth <- ifelse(
  Reg_clim_upto2025$day >= 15,
  Reg_clim_upto2025$month,
  ifelse(Reg_clim_upto2025$month == 1, 12, Reg_clim_upto2025$month - 1)
)

```

# export 

```{r}
write.csv(Reg_clim_upto2025, "F:/VFT/VFT_github/zyao78VFTcode/local adaptation/data/processed data/Reg_clim_upto2025.csv")
```
